descriptions.intend_create: The user wants the assistant to create a new alarm.
descriptions.intend_enable: The user wants the assistant to turn an existing alarm on.
descriptions.intend_disable: The user wants the assistant to turn an existing alarm off without deleting it.
descriptions.intend_delete: The user wants the assistant to cancel or delete an existing alarm.
